strategy.summary: Defend the center autoplunge, then test a vari-target return. Repeat safe vari-targets or use upper drop targets and aligned 5,000-point horseshoes.

quickInfo.name: Center autoplunge
quickInfo.summary: A flipper stroke serves each new ball from the outhole between the lower flippers.

quickInfo.name: Vari-target route
quickInfo.summary: The vari-targets score well only when their returns avoid the bumpers and fall safely toward a flipper.

quickInfo.name: Upper drop banks
quickInfo.summary: The two upper five-target banks provide the main broad targets during upper-playfield flow.

quickInfo.name: Corner horseshoes
quickInfo.summary: Each upper corner horseshoe scores 5,000 when the ball and upper flipper align for the shot.

quickInfo.name: Side-lane bumpers
quickInfo.summary: A double or triple side-lane feed can produce 1,000-point bumper hits before the ball reaches an outlane.

steps.text: Prepare both lower flippers before the first flipper stroke serves the ball.
Track the full center autoplunge and defend a weak return.
Send the ball toward the upper drop-target banks.
When an upper flipper aligns with a corner horseshoe, shoot it for 5,000.
Test one vari-target and watch whether the return reaches a flipper safely.
Repeat the vari-target only when it avoids the bumpers and center drain.
Otherwise, continue upper drop-target and horseshoe play.
Nudge side-lane feeds for bumper action before the ball reaches an outlane.

fallback.title: Upper-target flow
fallback.when: Use this plan when either vari-target sends the ball into bumpers or toward the center drain.

steps.text: Stop direct vari-target shots.
Send the ball to the upper drop-target banks.
Flip through a corner horseshoe only when the upper-flipper alignment is clear.
Use double and triple side-lane feeds for natural bumper action.
Repeat upper play without trying to cradle on an upper flipper.

alternatives.title: Run-counting Home Run
alternatives.when: Use this plan only when the tournament counts runs and at least two runners are on base.

steps.text: Confirm that the event counts runs.
Wait until at least two runners are on base.
Choose a corner horseshoe or a tested vari-target.
Make the Home Run shot before returning to normal point play.
Defend the center autoplunge.
Test one vari-target return.
Repeat that vari-target when its return reaches a flipper.
Use upper drops and 5,000-point horseshoes when the vari-target is unsafe.
Preserve the ball through each side-lane bumper feed.

techniques.name: Autoplunge defense
techniques.instruction: Prepare both lower flippers before the serve. Track a weak autoplunge until it clears the center drain area.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper flow shot
techniques.instruction: Do not try to cradle on an upper flipper. Shoot the drop bank or corner horseshoe while the ball is moving.

techniques.name: Side-lane bumper nudge
techniques.instruction: Nudge a double or triple lane feed for more 1,000-point bumper contacts. Stop before the ball reaches the outlane path.

cautions.issue: A weak center autoplunge can rise briefly and fall back through the lower center.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready during every serve. Defend the ball before you select a scoring shot.

cautions.issue: A drop-target hit sends the ball sideways even when the shot succeeds.
cautions.response: Track the rebound across the upper playfield. Do not assume a completed drop hit gives control.

cautions.issue: The outside of a vari-target chute can deflect the ball down the center.
cautions.response: Stop vari-target play after one unsafe return. Use upper drops and aligned horseshoes instead.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm the single-player 1977 Gottlieb Big Hit, ball count, tilt, replay and Special treatment, and whether the event scores points, runs, or both.
Test the center autoplunge from both lower-flipper buttons, both vari-target depths and returns, upper drop registration, four flippers, and corner horseshoes.
Observe both double and triple side-lane feeds, 1,000-point bumper registration, center-chute returns, and any weak serve before choosing the repeatable route.
strategy.simpleOverview: Big Hit serves each ball from a center autoplunge when a flipper moves, so defend that return first. Use upper drop banks and aligned 5,000-point corner horseshoes for broad scoring, and repeat a vari-target only after a full-depth hit returns safely.
strategy.overview: Big Hit serves each ball from a center autoplunge when a flipper moves, so defend that return first. Prepare both lower flippers before serving, favor broad upper targets, and take a horseshoe when an upper flipper aligns. Test one vari-target and keep it only if the complete return avoids the bumpers and center drain.
